"""Candidate readings of the four audit-rejected units, each as its own checked document.

A reading set in a `ve-document@1` cannot hold norm content (a candidate's `content` must be a
formula), so each norm-kind candidate is elaborated here as a one-unit companion document whose
source is exactly the unit's bytes. The main translation cites each companion's meaning id.
"""

def sort(singular, plural, description):
    return {"description": description, "verbalisation": {"singular": singular, "plural": plural}}


def prohibition_predicate(arguments, description, act):
    """A permission-role predicate that only the unconditional rule below decides.

    The rule's guard is true for every tuple of the named sorts, so the completion
    `allow` is never consulted; `default_independence` in build.py checks that.
    """
    return {"arguments": arguments, "description": description,
            "regulated": {"role": "permission", "default": "allow", "act": act}}


def environment(profiles, sorts, predicates):
    return {"language": "ve.core@0.2", "profiles": sorted(profiles), "spec_revision": SPEC_REVISION,
            "vocabulary": {"constants": {}, "predicates": predicates, "sorts": sorts}}


def strict_rule(name, predicate, sign):
    return {"norm": {"guard": ["top"], "name": name, "over": [], "predicate": predicate,
                     "sign": sign, "unless": []}}


def default_rule(name, predicate, sign):
    rule = strict_rule(name, predicate, sign)
    rule["norm"].update(mode="default", exception={"decided_by": UNSTATED, "factors": [],
                                                    "necessary": [], "sufficient": []})
    return rule

def write_companion(directory: Path, unit_id: str, candidate: str, source: bytes, open_terms: list):
    profiles, sorts, predicates, rule, unit_open = COMPANIONS[unit_id][candidate]
    meta = {"format": "ve-document@1",
            "environment": environment(profiles, sorts, predicates),
            "open_terms": [copy.deepcopy(t) for t in open_terms if t["name"] in unit_open],
            "units": [{"content": rule, "id": f"{unit_id}_{candidate}", "kind": "norm",
                       "meaning": {"open": list(unit_open)}, "span": [0, len(source)],
                       "support": "none"}]}
    path = directory / f"{unit_id}.{candidate}.ve.md"
    path.write_bytes(b"---\n" + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode()
                     + b"\n---\n" + source)
    return path


def open_term(name, factors, decided_by=UNSTATED):
    """An open term the source leaves undecided; no necessary or sufficient condition is invented."""
    return {"arguments": [], "decided_by": decided_by, "factors": factors, "jurisdiction": "universal",
            "name": name, "necessary": [], "precedents": [], "sufficient": [], "version": 1}

"""Norm candidates under norm-defaults@0: every completion is `unspecified`, every scope sits in a checked guard.

The 2026-10-01 run kept a prohibition or a duty as a norm over a sort whose *description* carried the source's
conditions (prose-scoped), with a declared completion (`allow`/`deny`) that the source never states. Here the
scope is a guard over declared base predicates and the completion is `unspecified`, so VE reports every case the
text does not decide as UNDECIDED. A document cannot enable norm-defaults@0 together with soft-norms@0 or rights@0
(ve/document.py: "norm-defaults@0 documents on the soft and rights routes await the Lean route"), so these
candidates are companion documents (one unit, source = the unit's exact bytes) cited by the main document's
reading sets, as in companions.py.

Predicates have at most two arguments and act phrases at most 80 bytes of plain words (no and/or/for/if/is/no/not),
so a case argument stands for a whole case (an act, a determination) and a long clause can force UNFORMALISED.
"""

# limitation was tied to no person and no right): the duty is on a bearer (a State, or any State, group or person), who
# must avoid imposing a limitation; a limitation here is one limitation on one person's exercise of one right or
# freedom, so the affected person and the right are the element's own (the language has no relation from a limitation to
# a right line: limitation scope names rights, which are open sets). The conditions are necessary, never sufficient:
# the rule bars every limitation that misses a condition and leaves every other limitation open (UNDECIDED).
# Two readings of "solely for the purpose of A and of B" (one or both of the two aims, only these; or both aims), two
# forces for "shall" (strict; defeasible, with an open exception) and two bearers.

def _u111_guard(both, state):
    aims = And(Unary("serves_recognition_of_rights_of_others", V0), Unary("serves_just_requirements", V0)) if both \
        else Or(Unary("serves_recognition_of_rights_of_others", V0), Unary("serves_just_requirements", V0))
    miss = Not(And(Unary("is_determined_by_law", V0), And(Not(Unary("serves_any_other_purpose", V0)), aims)))
    return And(Unary("is_state", V1), miss) if state else miss


def _u111_witnesses(both, state):
    # l0 serves only the first aim, l1 is not determined by law, l2 serves both aims, l3 serves another purpose too;
    # b0 is a State, b1 is not
    rels = {"is_determined_by_law": [["l0"], ["l2"], ["l3"]],
            "serves_recognition_of_rights_of_others": [["l0"], ["l1"], ["l2"], ["l3"]],
            "serves_just_requirements": [["l2"]], "serves_any_other_purpose": [["l3"]],
            "is_state": [["b0"]]}
    def status(b, i, v):
        return ("avoid_imposing_limitation_required", (b, f"l{i}"),
                ("SETTLED", True) if v else ("UNDECIDED", None))
    checks = [status("b0", 0, both), status("b0", 1, True), status("b0", 2, False), status("b0", 3, True),
              status("b1", 1, not state)]
    return [({"bearer": ["b0", "b1"], "limitation": ["l0", "l1", "l2", "l3"]}, rels, checks)]


def _u111(both, soft, state):

                "avoid_imposing_limitation_required", True, _u111_guard(both, state))
    if soft:
        free["avoid_imposing_limitation_required"]["regulated"]["default"] = "deny"
        rule["norm"].update(mode="default", exception={"decided_by": UNSTATED, "factors": [], "necessary": [],
                                                       "sufficient": []})
    return dict(sorts={"bearer": BEARER, "limitation": LIMITATION}, predicates={**U111_BASE, "is_state": IS_STATE_BASE, **free},
                rule=rule, open=U111_OPEN, soft=soft, witnesses=[] if soft else _u111_witnesses(both, state))

def write_companion(directory: Path, unit_id: str, candidate: str, source: bytes, open_terms: list) -> Path:
    spec = SPECS[unit_id][candidate]
    profiles = (*(p for p in PROFILES if not spec.get("soft") or p != "norm-defaults@0"),
                *(("soft-norms@0",) if spec.get("soft") else ()))
    meta = {"format": "ve-document@1",
            "environment": environment(profiles, spec["sorts"], spec["predicates"]),
            "open_terms": [copy.deepcopy(t) for t in open_terms if t["name"] in spec["open"]],
            "units": [{"content": spec["rule"], "id": f"{unit_id}_{candidate}", "kind": "norm",
                       "meaning": ({"open": list(spec["open"])} if spec["open"] else "specified"),
                       "span": [0, len(source)], "support": "none"}]}
    path = directory / f"{unit_id}.{candidate}.ve.md"
    path.write_bytes(b"---\n" + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode()
                     + b"\n---\n" + source)
    return path

GUARDIAN = sort("guardian", "guardians", "a parent or guardian of a person")


def guardian_duty(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, opens):
    """An obligation of a guardian towards a person, in force only where the guardian is a parent or guardian of the person."""
    rel = "is_parent_or_guardian_of"
    spec = dict(sorts={"guardian": GUARDIAN, "person": PERSON},
                predicates={rel: base(["guardian", "person"], "The guardian is a parent or guardian of the person",
                                      "{0} is a parent or guardian of {1}"),
                            stem: regulated(["guardian", "person"], "obligation", desc, act)},
                rule=norm(slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, Binary(rel, V1, V0)), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = [({"guardian": ["g0", "g1"], "person": ["p0", "p1"]}, {rel: [["g0", "p0"]]},
                          [(stem, ("g0", "p0"), ("SETTLED", True)), (stem, ("g0", "p1"), ("UNDECIDED", None)),
                           (stem, ("g1", "p0"), ("UNDECIDED", None))])]
    return spec

"""Repaired candidates of the units the 2026-10-05T1800Z audit rejected (previous-20261005T1800Z/AUDIT.md), and the units with the same defect.

"""Repaired candidates of the nine units the 2026-10-04T0600Z audit rejected (or that share a rejected unit's sentence).

The audit (AUDIT.md of run-20261004T0600Z) rejected u022a, u022c, u046, u054, u087, u098 and u099b. Its reasons and the repairs:

* u022a, u022c (and u022b, the same sentence): candidates replaced the unspecified responsibility with duties on every State
  or on every State, group and person, and no reading combined protection with noninterference. Repaired: the universal
  positive duty (anyone_positive) is gone, a plain entitlement candidate leaves the bearer unspecified, and a State candidate
  combines noninterference with protection in one act phrase.
* u046: "such interference or attacks" was unresolved. Repaired: the case sort's own definition carries the antecedent
  (arbitrary interference with privacy, family, home or correspondence; attacks upon honour or reputation), with a second scope
  where 'such' names the domains only.
* u054: the claim depended on the open relation owes_nationality_to (empty = no entitlement), and the permission-only liberty
  weakened the entitlement. Repaired: one candidate, a plain categorical entitlement of every person; claim and liberty removed.
* u087: the purpose clause was missing and the positive candidates required actual formation. Repaired: the purpose is in every act
  phrase, the positive candidate secures the opportunity (State only), the plain entitlement leaves the bearer open.
* u098: the age gate was invented and the parent/guardian responsibility was only a note. Repaired: no gate; a person candidate
  without a gate, a parent-or-guardian candidate, the State candidate.
* u099b (and u099a, the same sentence): the 'anyone' candidate gave every person and group a universal individual duty the passive
  does not assign; removed, the State candidate stays.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import udhr_specs as U
from udhr_specs import (AND, OR, PERSON, STATE, V0, Top, ast, base, case_bases, case_sort, data, duty, liberty, norm, regulated,
                        sort)

def entitlement(unit, cid, stem, verbalisation, desc, opens, case=None):
    """A plain regulated predicate (norms 3.1, role plain, completion 'unspecified') that the rule makes true of every holder.

    It states the entitlement itself and names no bearer, so nothing about who must do what is invented, and no open
    relation can empty it."""
    if case is None:
        sorts = {"person": PERSON}
        args, predicates, guard, var = ["person"], {}, Top(), V0
    else:
        sorts = {case["name"]: case["sort"]}
        args, predicates, guard, var = [case["name"]], case_bases(case), ast(case["guard"], V0, V0), V0
    predicates[stem] = {"arguments": args, "description": desc, "verbalisation": verbalisation,
                        "regulated": {"role": "plain", "default": "unspecified"}}
    spec = dict(sorts=sorts, predicates=predicates, rule=norm(U.slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, guard), open=list(opens),
                soft=False)
    if case is None:
        spec["witnesses"] = [({"person": ["p0"]}, {}, [(stem, ("p0",), ("SETTLED", True))])]
    else:
        elems = [f"c{i}" for i in range(len(case["examples"]))]
        rels = {n: [[e] for e, t in zip(elems, case["examples"]) if n in t] for n in case["bases"]}
        checks = [(stem, (e,), ("SETTLED", True) if U.holds(case["guard"], set(), set(t)) else ("UNDECIDED", None))
                  for e, t in zip(elems, case["examples"])]
        spec["witnesses"] = [({case["name"]: elems}, rels, checks)]
    return spec

        "carry the positive duty; a universal duty of every State, group and person to protect would strengthen the source.")
    _cstem = _nstem.replace("avoid_", "avoid_and_secure_")
    add(_uid, "state_combined",
        duty(_uid, "state_combined", _cstem, _cact, f"The bearer is required to {_cact[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'the person')}",
             bearer="state", arity="person", opens=[]),
        f"Claim reading of {_text} combining noninterference with protection: every State must {_cact[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'each holder')} "
        "(one act phrase, so the combination is one duty).")

# ---- Article 12: u046 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_INTERFERENCE = OR(("p", "concerns_privacy"), ("p", "concerns_family"), ("p", "concerns_home"), ("p", "concerns_correspondence"))
_ATTACK = OR(("p", "is_attack_upon_honour"), ("p", "is_attack_upon_reputation"))
_U046_BASES = {
    "concerns_privacy": "The intrusion is an interference with the privacy of the person",
    "concerns_family": "The intrusion is an interference with the family of the person",
    "concerns_home": "The intrusion is an interference with the home of the person",
    "concerns_correspondence": "The intrusion is an interference with the correspondence of the person",
    "is_arbitrary": "The intrusion is arbitrary",
    "is_attack_upon_honour": "The intrusion is an attack upon the honour of the person",
    "is_attack_upon_reputation": "The intrusion is an attack upon the reputation of the person"}
_U046_EX = [["concerns_privacy", "is_arbitrary"], ["concerns_family", "is_arbitrary"], ["concerns_home", "is_arbitrary"],
            ["concerns_correspondence", "is_arbitrary"], ["concerns_home"], ["is_arbitrary"], ["is_attack_upon_honour"],
            ["is_attack_upon_reputation"]]
for _scope, _guard, _text in (
        ("arbitrary", OR(AND(_INTERFERENCE, ("p", "is_arbitrary")), _ATTACK),
         "'such interference' is the arbitrary interference with privacy, family, home or correspondence that the preceding "
         "sentence names (arbitrariness included), and 'attacks' are the attacks upon honour or reputation named there"),
        ("any", OR(_INTERFERENCE, _ATTACK),
         "'such interference' names only the four domains of the preceding sentence (privacy, family, home, correspondence), "
         "whether arbitrary or not, and 'attacks' are the attacks upon honour or reputation named there")):
    case = case_sort(
        "intrusion", "intrusions",
        "one interference with the privacy, family, home or correspondence of one person, or one attack upon the honour or "
        "reputation of one person: the interference and the attacks named in the preceding sentence of Article 12",
        _U046_BASES, _guard, _U046_EX)
    add("u046", f"state_{_scope}",
        duty("u046", f"state_{_scope}", "protect_by_law_against_intrusion_required", "{0} protect by law against {1}",
             "The bearer is required to protect the person by law against the intrusion", bearer="state", arity="case", case=case,
             opens=["arbitrary"]),
        f"Article 12 second sentence: every State must protect each person by law against such interference or attacks; {_text}. "
        "The protection of the law is the State's (a universal duty of every person and group to give it would strengthen the source).")
    add("u046", f"entitlement_{_scope}",
        entitlement("u046", f"entitlement_{_scope}", "is_protected_by_law", "{0} is protected by law",
                    "The intrusion is one against which the law protects the person", ["arbitrary"], case=case),
        f"Entitlement reading of the right to the protection of the law: against each intrusion in scope the person is entitled to "
        f"it; {_text}. No bearer is named.")

# ---- Article 15(1): u054 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
add("u054", "entitlement",
    entitlement("u054", "entitlement", "is_entitled_to_a_nationality", "{0} is entitled to a nationality",
                "The person is entitled to a nationality; who, if anyone, must grant it is the open term "
                "bearer_of_the_nationality_duty", ["bearer_of_the_nationality_duty"]),
    "Article 15(1) as a categorical entitlement of every person (a plain regulated predicate the rule makes true of every person). "
    "No bearer is named and no open relation can empty the entitlement; the right is not read as already fulfilled, and the person "
    "is not obliged to accept a nationality. Removed after the audit: the claim guarded by owes_nationality_to (it could leave "
    "everyone without the entitlement) and the permission-only liberty (it weakens an entitlement to a permission).")

# ---- Article 23(4): u087 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_PURPOSE = "to protect their interests"
_U087 = {
    "negative": ("avoid_trade_unions_required", "{0} leave {1} free to form as well as join trade unions to protect interests"),
    "positive": ("secure_trade_unions_required", "{0} enable {1} to form as well as join trade unions " + _PURPOSE),
}
for _b, _who in (("state", "every State"), ("anyone", "every State, group and person")):
    _stem, _act = _U087["negative"]
    add("u087", f"{_b}_negative",
        duty("u087", f"{_b}_negative", _stem, _act, f"The bearer is required to {_act[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'the person')}",
             bearer=_b, arity="person", opens=[]),
        f"Claim reading of the right to form and to join trade unions for the protection of one's interests as noninterference: "
        f"{_who} must leave each holder free to form as well as join trade unions to protect interests (the "
        "purpose clause is in the act phrase).")
_stem, _act = _U087["positive"]
add("u087", "state_positive",
    duty("u087", "state_positive", _stem, _act, f"The bearer is required to {_act[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'the person')}",
         bearer="state", arity="person", opens=[]),
    "Claim reading as enabling: every State must enable each holder to form as well as join trade unions to protect their interests "
    "(the opportunity, not the formation or joining itself, which stays the holder's choice).")
add("u087", "liberty",
    liberty("u087", "liberty", "person_may_form_and_join_trade_unions",
            "{0} form as well as join trade unions " + _PURPOSE,
            "The person is permitted to form as well as join trade unions to protect their interests", []),
    "Liberty reading: each person is permitted to form as well as join trade unions to protect their interests (the permission names "
    "no other case and grants nothing to anyone else).")
add("u087", "entitlement",
    entitlement("u087", "entitlement", "has_the_right_to_form_and_join_trade_unions",
                "{0} has the right to form as well as join trade unions to protect their interests",
                "The person has the right to form and to join trade unions for the protection of their interests", []),
    "Entitlement reading: every person has the right, and the source names no one who must do anything, so no bearer is named.")

# ---- Article 26(1): u098, u099a, u099b ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GUARDIAN = sort("guardian", "guardians", "a parent or guardian of a person")


def gated_free_person_duty(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, opens):
    spec = dict(sorts={"person": PERSON}, predicates={stem: regulated(["person"], "obligation", desc, act)},
                rule=norm(U.slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, Top()), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = [({"person": ["p0"]}, {}, [(stem, ("p0",), ("SETTLED", True))])]
    return spec


def guardian_duty(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, opens):
    spec = dict(sorts={"guardian": GUARDIAN, "person": PERSON},
                predicates={stem: regulated(["guardian", "person"], "obligation", desc, act)},
                rule=norm(U.slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, Top()), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = [({"guardian": ["g0"], "person": ["p0"]}, {}, [(stem, ("g0", "p0"), ("SETTLED", True))])]
    return spec


add("u098", "state_requires",
    duty("u098", "state_requires", "make_elementary_education_compulsory_required",
         "{0} make elementary education compulsory", "The bearer is required to make elementary education compulsory",
         bearer="state", arity="bearer", opens=["compulsory"]),
    "Article 26(1) read as a duty on every State to make elementary education compulsory (the passive names no one who makes it "
    "so). Who must attend, and to what age, is the open term compulsory.")
add("u098", "person_attends",
    gated_free_person_duty("u098", "person_attends", "attend_compulsory_elementary_education_required",
                           "{0} attend compulsory elementary education",
                           "The person is required to attend elementary education that is compulsory for the person", ["compulsory"]),
    "Article 26(1) read as a duty on a person to attend the elementary education that is compulsory for them. Who it is compulsory "
    "for is the open term compulsory (no age is stated and none is invented here, so no gate can leave everyone outside the duty).")
add("u098", "guardian_ensures",
    guardian_duty("u098", "guardian_ensures", "see_to_compulsory_elementary_education_required",
                  "{0} see that {1} attends compulsory elementary education",
                  "The parent or guardian is required to see that the person attends elementary education that is compulsory for the "
                  "person", ["compulsory"]),
    "Article 26(1) read as a duty of a parent or guardian to see that the person in their care attends the elementary education that is "
    "compulsory for that person (the open term compulsory decides for whom it is).")

for _uid in ("u099a", "u099b"):
    for _cid, _spec, _why in U.CANDIDATES[_uid]:
        if _cid == "state":
            CANDIDATES.setdefault(_uid, []).append((_cid, _spec, _why.replace(
                "read as a duty on every State", "read as a duty on every State (the only bearer the sentence can carry: the passive "
                "assigns no universal individual duty)")))

# Universal Declaration of Human Rights

## Preamble

Whereas recognition of the inherent dignity and of the equal and inalienable rights of all members of the human family is the foundation of freedom, justice and peace in the world,

Whereas disregard and contempt for human rights have resulted in barbarous acts which have outraged the conscience of mankind, and the advent of a world in which human beings shall enjoy freedom of speech and belief and freedom from fear and want has been proclaimed as the highest aspiration of the common people,

Whereas it is essential, if man is not to be compelled to have recourse, as a last resort, to rebellion against tyranny and oppression, that human rights should be protected by the rule of law,

Whereas it is essential to promote the development of friendly relations between nations,

Whereas the peoples of the United Nations have in the Charter reaffirmed their faith in fundamental human rights, in the dignity and worth of the human person and in the equal rights of men and women and have determined to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom,

Whereas Member States have pledged themselves to achieve, in co-operation with the United Nations, the promotion of universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms,

Whereas a common understanding of these rights and freedoms is of the greatest importance for the full realization of this pledge,

Now, therefore,

The General Assembly,

Proclaims this Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a common standard of achievement for all peoples and all nations, to the end that every individual and every organ of society, keeping this Declaration constantly in mind, shall strive by teaching and education to promote respect for these rights and freedoms and by progressive measures, national and international, to secure their universal and effective recognition and observance, both among the peoples of Member States themselves and among the peoples of territories under their jurisdiction.

## Article 1

All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

## Article 2

Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status. Furthermore, no distinction shall be made on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status of the country or territory to which a person belongs, whether it be independent, trust, non-self-governing or under any other limitation of sovereignty.

## Article 3

Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.

## Article 4

No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms.

## Article 5

No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.

## Article 6

Everyone has the right to recognition everywhere as a person before the law.

## Article 7

All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law. All are entitled to equal protection against any discrimination in violation of this Declaration and against any incitement to such discrimination.

## Article 8

Everyone has the right to an effective remedy by the competent national tribunals for acts violating the fundamental rights granted him by the constitution or by law.

## Article 9

No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.

## Article 10

Everyone is entitled in full equality to a fair and public hearing by an independent and impartial tribunal, in the determination of his rights and obligations and of any criminal charge against him.

## Article 11

1. Everyone charged with a penal offence has the right to be presumed innocent until proved guilty according to law in a public trial at which he has had all the guarantees necessary for his defence.

2. No one shall be held guilty of any penal offence on account of any act or omission which did not constitute a penal offence, under national or international law, at the time when it was committed. Nor shall a heavier penalty be imposed than the one that was applicable at the time the penal offence was committed.

## Article 12

No one shall be subjected to arbitrary interference with his privacy, family, home or correspondence, nor to attacks upon his honour and reputation. Everyone has the right to the protection of the law against such interference or attacks.

## Article 13

1. Everyone has the right to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each state.

2. Everyone has the right to leave any country, including his own, and to return to his country.

## Article 14

1. Everyone has the right to seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution.

2. This right may not be invoked in the case of prosecutions genuinely arising from non-political crimes or from acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

## Article 15

1. Everyone has the right to a nationality.

2. No one shall be arbitrarily deprived of his nationality nor denied the right to change his nationality.

## Article 16

1. Men and women of full age, without any limitation due to race, nationality or religion, have the right to marry and to found a family. They are entitled to equal rights as to marriage, during marriage and at its dissolution.

2. Marriage shall be entered into only with the free and full consent of the intending spouses.

3. The family is the natural and fundamental group unit of society and is entitled to protection by society and the State.

## Article 17

1. Everyone has the right to own property alone as well as in association with others.

2. No one shall be arbitrarily deprived of his property.

## Article 18

Everyone has the right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion; this right includes freedom to change his religion or belief, and freedom, either alone or in community with others and in public or private, to manifest his religion or belief in teaching, practice, worship and observance.

## Article 19

Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression; this right includes freedom to hold opinions without interference and to seek, receive and impart information and ideas through any media and regardless of frontiers.

## Article 20

1. Everyone has the right to freedom of peaceful assembly and association.

2. No one may be compelled to belong to an association.

## Article 21

1. Everyone has the right to take part in the government of his country, directly or through freely chosen representatives.

2. Everyone has the right of equal access to public service in his country.

3. The will of the people shall be the basis of the authority of government; this will shall be expressed in periodic and genuine elections which shall be by universal and equal suffrage and shall be held by secret vote or by equivalent free voting procedures.

## Article 22

Everyone, as a member of society, has the right to social security and is entitled to realization, through national effort and international co-operation and in accordance with the organization and resources of each State, of the economic, social and cultural rights indispensable for his dignity and the free development of his personality.

## Article 23

1. Everyone has the right to work, to free choice of employment, to just and favourable conditions of work and to protection against unemployment.

2. Everyone, without any discrimination, has the right to equal pay for equal work.

3. Everyone who works has the right to just and favourable remuneration ensuring for himself and his family an existence worthy of human dignity, and supplemented, if necessary, by other means of social protection.

4. Everyone has the right to form and to join trade unions for the protection of his interests.

## Article 24

Everyone has the right to rest and leisure, including reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.

## Article 25

1. Everyone has the right to a standard of living adequate for the health and well-being of himself and of his family, including food, clothing, housing and medical care and necessary social services, and the right to security in the event of unemployment, sickness, disability, widowhood, old age or other lack of livelihood in circumstances beyond his control.

2. Motherhood and childhood are entitled to special care and assistance. All children, whether born in or out of wedlock, shall enjoy the same social protection.

## Article 26

1. Everyone has the right to education. Education shall be free, at least in the elementary and fundamental stages. Elementary education shall be compulsory. Technical and professional education shall be made generally available and higher education shall be equally accessible to all on the basis of merit.

2. Education shall be directed to the full development of the human personality and to the strengthening of respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms. It shall promote understanding, tolerance and friendship among all nations, racial or religious groups, and shall further the activities of the United Nations for the maintenance of peace.

3. Parents have a prior right to choose the kind of education that shall be given to their children.

## Article 27

1. Everyone has the right freely to participate in the cultural life of the community, to enjoy the arts and to share in scientific advancement and its benefits.

2. Everyone has the right to the protection of the moral and material interests resulting from any scientific, literary or artistic production of which he is the author.

## Article 28

Everyone is entitled to a social and international order in which the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration can be fully realized.

## Article 29

1. Everyone has duties to the community in which alone the free and full development of his personality is possible.

2. In the exercise of his rights and freedoms, everyone shall be subject only to such limitations as are determined by law solely for the purpose of securing due recognition and respect for the rights and freedoms of others and of meeting the just requirements of morality, public order and the general welfare in a democratic society.

3. These rights and freedoms may in no case be exercised contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

## Article 30

Nothing in this Declaration may be interpreted as implying for any State, group or person any right to engage in any activity or to perform any act aimed at the destruction of any of the rights and freedoms set forth herein.

"""Norm candidates of the 39 content-bearing units, as norm-defaults@0 companion documents (completion `unspecified`).

The 2026-10-03 audit rejected every sampled unit whose candidates declared the completion `deny` ("not required")
or `permission deny`: the source never says nothing else is required or permitted. norm-defaults@0 is the profile
that leaves such cases UNDECIDED, and it cannot sit beside readings@1 content, rights@0 or soft-norms@0 in one
document. So each candidate of the units below is a one-unit companion document (source = the unit's exact bytes)
cited by the main document's reading set, as the repaired units of the previous run already were.

What changed against the previous run's candidates, from the audit and the 2026-10-03 rules:

* no defeasible twin of a 'shall' or of 'has the right' (the text states no exception for them; Article 22's
  resources clause is attached by the text to the entitlement of u082, not to the rights of Articles 23-27);
* an explicit enumeration is structure: a case sort whose base predicates are the enumerated items and a guard that
  lists them (torture, cruel, inhuman, degrading, treatment, punishment; privacy, family, home, correspondence;
  slavery, servitude; ...), never an open factor;
* a cause for an open term stays an open term ('arbitrary', 'cruel') as a base predicate that the guard requires;
* u025's 'shall be prohibited' keeps a duty to prohibit and a prohibition of the practice, never 'avoid';
* every liberty candidate is a permission under `unspecified`, and 'freely' and the freedoms offer one.

A rule's guard is a necessary condition of its norm: where the guard fails VE reports UNDECIDED, never 'not required'.

DSL: a guard is a nested tuple ("p", name) | ("b", name) | ("and", g, h) | ("or", g, h) | ("not", g) | ("top",);
("p", ...) names a base predicate of the case (the last argument), ("b", ...) a base predicate of the bearer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

from ve.ast import And, Not, Or, Top, Unary, Var
from ve.ast import _to_data as data

from companions import environment, sort

PROFILES = ("documents@1", "norm-defaults@0", "norms@0", "relational-fol@0")
V0, V1 = Var(0), Var(1)
RESERVED = {"true", "false", "is", "equals", "not", "and", "or", "if", "then", "for", "every", "there", "exists",
            "believes", "must", "eventually", "no"}

BEARER = sort("bearer", "bearers", "a State, group or person")
PERSON = sort("person", "people", "a human person")


def base(arguments, description, verbalisation):
    return {"arguments": arguments, "description": description, "verbalisation": verbalisation}


def regulated(arguments, role, description, act):
    assert len(act.encode()) <= 80, act
    assert not RESERVED & set(act.replace("{0}", "").replace("{1}", "").replace("'", " ").lower().split()), act
    assert "," not in act, act
    return {"arguments": arguments, "description": description,
            "regulated": {"role": role, "default": "unspecified", "act": act}}




# ------------------------------------------------------------------ guards
def ast(guard, bearer_var, case_var):
    tag = guard[0]
    if tag == "top":
        return Top()
    if tag == "p":
        return Unary(guard[1], case_var)
    if tag == "b":
        return Unary(guard[1], bearer_var)
    if tag == "not":
        return Not(ast(guard[1], bearer_var, case_var))
    left, right = ast(guard[1], bearer_var, case_var), ast(guard[2], bearer_var, case_var)
    return And(left, right) if tag == "and" else Or(left, right)


def holds(guard, bearer_true, case_true):
    tag = guard[0]
    if tag == "top":
        return True
    if tag == "p":
        return guard[1] in case_true
    if tag == "b":
        return guard[1] in bearer_true
    if tag == "not":
        return not holds(guard[1], bearer_true, case_true)
    left, right = holds(guard[1], bearer_true, case_true), holds(guard[2], bearer_true, case_true)
    return (left and right) if tag == "and" else (left or right)


def AND(*gs):
    out = gs[0]
    for g in gs[1:]:
        out = ("and", out, g)
    return out


def OR(*gs):
    out = gs[0]
    for g in gs[1:]:
        out = ("or", out, g)
    return out


def norm(name, predicate, sign, guard):
    return {"norm": {"guard": data(guard), "name": name, "over": [], "predicate": predicate,
                     "sign": sign, "unless": []}}


def slug(text):
    return text.replace("_", "-")[:46]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ case sorts
def case_sort(singular, plural, description, bases, guard, examples):
    """A case sort: `bases` {name: description}, `guard` over them, `examples` lists of base names true of one element."""
    return dict(sort=sort(singular, plural, description), bases=bases, guard=guard, examples=examples,
                name=singular.replace(" ", "_"))


# English the renderer accepts for a unary base predicate is exactly "{0} is X" with one word X (ve/printer.py); where the
# clause has such a word it is used, elsewhere the wording stays plain and the document view shows the generic form.
VERB = {
    "is_slavery": "{0} is slavery", "is_servitude": "{0} is servitude", "is_torture": "{0} is torture",
    "is_treatment": "{0} is treatment", "is_punishment": "{0} is punishment", "is_arrest": "{0} is arrest",
    "is_detention": "{0} is detention", "is_exile": "{0} is exile", "is_technical": "{0} is technical",
    "is_professional": "{0} is professional", "based_on_political_status": "{0} is political",
    "based_on_jurisdictional_status": "{0} is jurisdictional", "based_on_international_status": "{0} is international",
}


def case_bases(case):
    return {n: base([case["name"]], d, VERB.get(n) or _verb(d)) for n, d in case["bases"].items()}


def _verb(description):
    # "The deprivation is arbitrary" -> "{0} is arbitrary"
    first, rest = description.split(" ", 1)
    assert first.lower() == "the", description
    words = rest.split(" ", 1)
    return "{0} " + words[1]

STATE = sort("State", "States", "a State")

    `bearer`: 'state' (the bearer sort is State: a rule over States only, every other party unmentioned) or 'anyone' (the
    bearer sort is a State, group or person)."""
    bsort = "state" if bearer == "state" else "bearer"
    sorts = {bsort: STATE if bearer == "state" else BEARER}
    predicates = {}
    if arity == "person":
        sorts["person"] = PERSON
        args = [bsort, "person"]
    elif arity == "bearer":
        args = [bsort]
    else:
        sorts[case["name"]] = case["sort"]
        args = [bsort, case["name"]]
        predicates.update(case_bases(case))
    bearer_var = V1 if len(args) == 2 else V0
    guards = []
    if resources:
        predicates["resources_allow"] = base(
            [bsort], "The organization and resources of the bearer allow it (the open term "
                     "organization_and_resources_of_each_state)", "{0} has the organization and resources for it")
        guards.append(("b", "resources_allow"))
    if case is not None:
        guards.append(case["guard"])
    guard = AND(*guards) if guards else ("top",)
    predicates[stem] = regulated(args, "obligation", desc, act)
    spec = dict(sorts=sorts, predicates=predicates,
                rule=norm(slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, ast(guard, bearer_var, V0)), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = duty_witnesses(stem, args, guard, case, bsort, resources)
    return spec


def duty_witnesses(stem, args, guard, case, bsort, resources):
    # bearer b0 has the organization and resources (when the rule asks), b1 has not
    b_true = {"b0": {"resources_allow"}, "b1": set()}
    bearers = ["b0", "b1"]
    rels = {"resources_allow": [["b0"]]} if resources else {}
    checks = []
    if case is not None:
        elems = [f"c{i}" for i in range(len(case["examples"]))]
        domains = {bsort: bearers, case["name"]: elems}
        for n in case["bases"]:
            rels[n] = [[e] for e, trues in zip(elems, case["examples"]) if n in trues]
        for b in bearers:
            for e, trues in zip(elems, case["examples"]):
                ok = holds(guard, b_true[b], set(trues))
                checks.append((stem, (b, e), ("SETTLED", True) if ok else ("UNDECIDED", None)))
    else:
        domains = {bsort: bearers}
        if "person" in args:
            domains["person"] = ["p0"]
        for b in bearers:
            ok = holds(guard, b_true[b], set())
            row = (b, "p0") if "person" in args else (b,)
            checks.append((stem, row, ("SETTLED", True) if ok else ("UNDECIDED", None)))
    return [(domains, rels, checks)]


def scoped_person_duty(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, scope_name, scope_desc, scope_verb, opens):
    """An obligation on a person, scoped by a named open relation of the person (u098: an age the source does not state)."""
    predicates = {scope_name: base(["person"], scope_desc, scope_verb),
                  stem: regulated(["person"], "obligation", desc, act)}
    guard = ("p", scope_name)
    spec = dict(sorts={"person": PERSON}, predicates=predicates,
                rule=norm(slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, ast(guard, V0, V0)), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = [({"person": ["p0", "p1"]}, {scope_name: [["p0"]]},
                          [(stem, ("p0",), ("SETTLED", True)), (stem, ("p1",), ("UNDECIDED", None))])]
    return spec


def liberty(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, opens):
    spec = dict(sorts={"person": PERSON},
                predicates={stem: regulated(["person"], "permission", desc, act)},
                rule=norm(slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, True, Top()), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    spec["witnesses"] = [({"person": ["p0"]}, {}, [(stem, ("p0",), ("SETTLED", True))])]
    return spec


def prohibition(unit, cid, stem, act, desc, case, opens):
    """The act itself is not permitted (sign False on a permission): the guard picks the prohibited cases."""
    predicates = {stem: regulated([case["name"]], "permission", desc, act), **case_bases(case)}
    spec = dict(sorts={case["name"]: case["sort"]}, predicates=predicates,
                rule=norm(slug(f"{unit}-{cid}"), stem, False, ast(case["guard"], V0, V0)), open=list(opens), soft=False)
    elems = [f"c{i}" for i in range(len(case["examples"]))]
    rels = {n: [[e] for e, trues in zip(elems, case["examples"]) if n in trues] for n in case["bases"]}
    checks = [(stem, (e,), ("SETTLED", False) if holds(case["guard"], set(), set(t)) else ("UNDECIDED", None))
              for e, t in zip(elems, case["examples"])]
    spec["witnesses"] = [({case["name"]: elems}, rels, checks)]
    return spec


def write_companion(directory: Path, unit_id: str, candidate: str, spec: dict, source: bytes, open_terms: list) -> Path:
    meta = {"format": "ve-document@1",
            "environment": environment(PROFILES, spec["sorts"], spec["predicates"]),
            "open_terms": [copy.deepcopy(t) for t in open_terms if t["name"] in spec["open"]],
            "units": [{"content": spec["rule"], "id": f"{unit_id}_{candidate}", "kind": "norm",
                       "meaning": ({"open": list(spec["open"])} if spec["open"] else "specified"),
                       "span": [0, len(source)], "support": "none"}]}
    path = directory / f"{unit_id}.{candidate}.ve.md"
    path.write_bytes(b"---\n" + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode()
                     + b"\n---\n" + source)
    return path

def right_unit(uid, spec):
    kind, neg, pos, lib, opens = spec
    text = RIGHT_TEXT[uid]
    if kind == "both":
        pairs = [("negative", neg, "avoid denying or harming the right"), ("positive", pos, "secure the right")]
    else:
        pairs = [("claim", pos, "the one duty the previous reading gave the right")]
    for b in ("state", "anyone"):
        for pol, (stem, act), what in pairs:
            cid = f"{b}_{pol}"
            who = BEARER_WHO[b]
            add(uid, cid, duty(uid, cid, stem, act,
                               f"The bearer is required to {act[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'the person')}",
                               bearer=b, arity="person", opens=opens),
                f"Claim reading of {text}: {who} must {act[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'each holder')} ({what}); the source "
                "names no bearer and no polarity, so this is the translator's candidate.")
    if uid == "u081":
        for b in ("state", "anyone"):
            stem, act = pos
            cid = f"{b}_claim_within_resources"
            add(uid, cid, duty(uid, cid, stem, act,
                               f"The bearer is required to {act[len('{0} '):].replace('{1}', 'the person')}",
                               bearer=b, arity="person", opens=opens + [RESOURCES_OPEN], resources=True),

                f"of each State': {BEARER_WHO[b]} must secure each holder social security where its organization and resources "
                "allow it (the necessary condition is a guard over the named open relation resources_allow, term "

            f"Liberty reading of {text}: each person is permitted to {act[len('{0} '):]} (the permission names no other case "
            "and grants nothing to anyone else).")

# Article 29(1): 'Everyone has duties to the community in which alone the free and full development of his personality is
# possible.' The relative clause is read two ways: as restricting which community the duties are owed to (a guard over the
# open relation is_sole_setting_of_full_development), or as describing the one community and setting no condition (the
# audit: with the relation empty nobody would have a duty, though the source says everyone has duties).
import companions_nd as ND  # noqa: E402

add("u110", "restrictive", ND.SPECS["u110"]["duty"],
    "Article 29(1) read with the relative clause as a restriction: the person owes duties to a community that is the one "
    "'in which alone the free and full development of his personality is possible' (a guard over the open relation "
    "is_sole_setting_of_full_development). Where no community stands in that relation the case is UNDECIDED, so this reading "
    "alone would leave the persons of such a case without a stated duty; the next candidate does not.")
add("u110", "describing",
    dict(sorts={"person": PERSON},
         predicates={"perform_duties_to_the_community_required": regulated(
             ["person"], "obligation",
             "The person is required to perform the duties the person has to the community in which alone the free and full "
             "development of the person's personality is possible",
             "{0} perform duties to the community of their free as well as full development")},
         rule=norm("everyone-performs-duties-to-the-community", "perform_duties_to_the_community_required", True, Top()),
         open=["duties_to_the_community", "free_and_full_development", "community_of_full_development"], soft=False,
         witnesses=[({"person": ["p0"]}, {}, [("perform_duties_to_the_community_required", ("p0",), ("SETTLED", True))])]),
    "Article 29(1) read with the relative clause as describing the one community the duties are owed to, not as a condition: every "
    "person has duties to it. The clause (that such a community exists, and that development is possible only in it) is carried "
    "by the act phrase and the open term community_of_full_development, not stated as a checked condition.")
OPEN_NEW["community_of_full_development"] = [
    "whether there is a community in which alone the free and full development of a personality is possible",
    "which community that is, for each person", "whether it is the same community for every person"]
